protocol.scope: Controlled CPU backend experiment; preserve the existing released encoder/matrix/gaps and exact filter semantics. No search repository edits.
protocol.queries: First 10 R1 validation queries by deterministic SHA256 R3 ordering; fixed across target strata and sizes
protocol.data: Existing SCOPe40 archive only; unique record ID, AA hash and raw structure hash; exclude query PDBs; single chain, complete backbone, >=95% valid peptide links
protocol.mixed_stratum: Additional 60-500 length pool for the 5000-target scaling point when individual length strata are too small
protocol.shortfall: Skip impossible sizes with exact available counts; never inflate by duplicating structures
protocol.selection: Nested target prefixes by SHA256('R3:'+record_id), independent of scores; length range is target length
protocol.comparisons: Cumulative changes, same candidate sets and scores; baseline Python traceback, last backend Numba traceback with identical tie rules and independent rescoring
protocol.order: Rotate backend order by repeat; execute serially
protocol.timing: Separate cold JIT, structure encoding, index conversion, array preparation, warm score-only search, top-1 traceback/rescore, output; report median and min/max
protocol.preflight: One smallest target condition per length stratum, project larger runs with a 3x work reserve; refuse estimates above remaining 4-hour/4GiB limits
protocol.adoption: Candidate/score/path equivalence first; >=1.5x warm total speedup at >=2 distinct target sizes. Filter retention relative to exhaustive is reported separately, never attributed to backend.
protocol.biological_claim: Throughput diagnostic using real structures, not a fresh biological test or training generalization study
